sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 24.3.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 26 of 2024, under sections 498A, 304B, 323, 504 I.P.C. and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Qualoria, District-Bareilly.
Further prayer has been made not to take coercive measures against the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays that he does not want to press this petition and the same may be dismissed as not pressed.

sentences.text: The prayer so made by learned counsel for the petitioner is allowed.

5. In view of the above, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed, leaving it open for the petitioner to apply before the competent court for anticipatory bail/bail as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
